title: BROKER_TIME — broker clock vs local KST skew

args.note: P0-2 T2 wave-3: MOCK STOCK credential validation (operator-provided 2026-07-29). Doubles as a stock-scope BROKER_TIME observation - the wave-1 P-16 artifact is futures-scoped.

abs_skew_bound_candidate.label: abs_skew_ms
abs_skew_bound_candidate.statistic: hard maximum: ceil(max_observed x (1 + margin_pct/100)). p95/p99 are shape diagnostics and MUST NOT be proposed as the bound.
abs_skew_bound_candidate.sample_adequacy_note: A maximum estimated from a small sample understates the true maximum. Record n and the observation window with the value; the Bounds-Approver decides whether n is adequate.

signed_skew.note: A one-sided skew is a systematic offset (correctable); a two-sided spread is jitter (not correctable). They imply different treatments and must not be merged.

measurements.rtt_confound: The HTTP Date header has 1-second granularity, so a sub-second skew is not resolvable from it. Treat any |skew| below ~1000 ms as 'within header resolution', not as a measurement.
measurements.precision_determination: Record precision from the field actually used, not from the finest field present. If only HHMMSS fields exist, precision is 1 s.

approval_note: This artifact records observations only. Writing any value into VERIFICATION-PROFILE-002.yaml requires a Bounds-Approver; writing any capability status into the Broker Capability Profile INSTANCE requires the P0-2 approval chain (draft memo §8).
